evidence: Row 51 is satisfied for the frozen bytes. Independent parse-results.json (SHA256 d467d45ef7edc190133c5f45b345819d2899b3f420631cbc8e7062ba01a60853) verifies all 37 task and 34 frozen rule file hashes against manifest input 6e0b8d2fb655781b3dbd8f4bde8d064dd48f8f7671ecd87f6a2db22b5c0aa8a1. It parses task.toml, tests/scoring.toml and all five judge.toml (7 TOML total), all 3 JSON files, all 9 JS files and both Python tools. Both solution/solve.sh and tests/test.sh pass bash -n, have #!/bin/bash shebangs and zero CR bytes. The generated restart shell, three Python heredocs and solve.sh JavaScript heredoc also parse. No frozen __pycache__ exists. Actual target-runtime corroboration: linux-parser-run.json records an isolated --network none container with the task mounted read-only using image sha256:a6e377e2468671fe2b676f3d211ca5c0cfdc4b68a98cffd1349b332ed59c6251. Linux Node v22.23.2, bash 5.2.37 and Python 3.12.14 accept all 23 examined task files; exit 0 and empty stderr. linux-parser.stdout.json SHA256 is 0ea25414d8e7b56a344dbc8f6eb5a30ea05988be4c46bf8f8dbb8ec355eac4aa. Executable entry wiring is concrete: solution/solve.sh:33 copies app files to /app; solution/app/server.js:2 requires ./src/index.js, whose bootstrap starts the worker; tests/test.sh:106-111 supplies NODE_PATH and DB_PATH then runs node "$APP_ENTRY". Independently hash-checked local/install-lifecycle/results.json (368261834b06931f2e8ac0fa0fd909a435e7ae28a6c30444c3ff48240d27bb24) and its driver bind all 13 app files, demonstrate fresh installation, sanitized unprivileged launch from /tests, authenticated bootstrap with 7 requisitions and 13 offers, saved-record readback, real process restart with persistence and closed-workspace reinstall. The active-reinstall rejection was an EACCES fail-closed refusal; it is not described as an exact active-database match. Installed RewardKit loader evidence is also byte-bound: local/configured-inspection/results.json SHA256 06c999a26c56bf9c378f0ffcea682d35422f1002d4cfc0c545817183e4340bcf matches the index and all 15 inspected test-source hashes. Its reviewed driver resolves app context, discovers all five dimensions, constructs prompts/response schemas and sends identical argument bytes to /usr/bin/true; every argument launch exits 0 with no unresolved placeholders. Largest argument is the 99,776-byte functional prompt, with 131,357 total command bytes. This establishes loader/schema/OS executability, not a provider invocation or full configured judge duration. Negative/conforming controls in parse-results.json: malformed JS is rejected with SyntaxError, duplicate TOML key is rejected, CRLF is counted separately, and a syntactically valid missing-module entry passes node --check but fails actual execution with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. A relocated CommonJS entry using __dirname loads from an unrelated cwd, so the review does not impose a hidden source layout. Reference runtime evidence closes the missing-module limitation for this candidate. Unrelated engine drift is reported to the coordinator without changing files: scripts/check_colderwater_current.py is cadbcb5c868b67cfa79011130d56226f0dbced1a6b3fc39fe7c5cbdf1bd5be23 versus manifest eee9f667ed04a2928b3413297bb5a647b819a6ddd12584de192181778ac38212. This does not invalidate the exact frozen row-51 parser observations, but global reconciliation must handle it. Full configured grading, Oracle/model/portal scores and the private deterministic checker suite were not run or inferred; their evidence requirements belong to their own rows.
